personality.style: creative, explosive shotmaker: drop shots, angles, big forehand

celebrations: big roar, arms spread to the crowd
personality.notes: public media; 'my personality is a little special', tennis is 'a rollercoaster'; has apologised for outbursts

'a rollercoaster with my mind' after the Draper match

reachM.note: Same formula as bodyStats() in index.html. Not a measured wingspan. datasets/players/<id>/body.json does not exist yet (Body Scout has not run).

letRate.note: Same range already used for Sinner (0.02) and Alcaraz (0.03): lets on roughly 1–3% of pro serves. Not counted from a match log.

skills.scale: 1–20, 10 = neutral, the Skills Coach scale in src/skills/skills.js
skills.note: Not a measured rating. Set from the published style already in this file (serve size, footspeed, touch) so the locker room is not all 10s.

torsoScale.note: look.torso in src/players/roster.js is a pixel width multiplier taken from words already in signature/exaggerate (lanky, broad, slim). It is not a measured shoulder width.

favouriteServes.summary: Variety and angles more than a serve weapon.
